## About

- At Kincentric: SaaS platform delivery and client management, including SSO setup, integrations and NPS/CSAT programmes.
- At Hive.ai: AI/ML data operations, including model evaluation; promoted within 14 months.
- Clients across Fortune 500, government and mid-market organisations in APAC, EMEA, the Americas and the Middle East.
- Certifications: PMP; Google Cloud Generative AI Leader; Anthropic AI Fluency: Frameworks & Foundations. B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering.

## Roles of interest
